name: Seth, Goblin

attacks.name: Knife / Shortbow
attacks.special: Hit or miss, sends the goblin curse!

specialRules: Quick: Attacks and defence are DR14.
Goblin Curse: Even being attacked sends the curse. Hit or miss, if the goblin still lives d6 days after the attack, the victim warps irrevocably into a goblin.
description: All goblins carry a curse. Once like you, now trapped in crazed goblin flesh. In the dark of Sarkash they shoot at passers-by with twanging bows.

name: Bent, Scum

attacks.name: Poisoned Knife
attacks.special: Test Toughness DR10 or become infected.

specialRules: Cowardly Backstab: The PC with highest Presence tests DR14 at start of battle. On failure, a random party member takes an automatic backstab for normal damage + 3.
description: Mothered by dark alleyways and slum misery. Few fiends are more fell than poverty or monsters more powerful than hate.

name: Zukuma, Berserker
specialRules: Attacks twice per round.
Doesn't have time for defense: DR10 to hit them.
description: They're on you! A frenzied ambush in dusty hallways and from behind the stacked black stones of catacombs.

name: Wrat, Wraith

attacks.name: Chilling Touch
attacks.special: Drains Strength, Presence, and Agility by 1 for duration of fight.

specialRules: Swift, elusive, and difficult to hit: DR14 to hit them.
Always wins initiative.
Morale: Fearless (undead).
description: Soundless phantoms born of ancient malice. Their freezing touch saps the soul and withers mortal sinew.

name: Belze, Blood-drenched Skeleton
specialRules: Skulks about, impossibly soundless. Attacks by surprise.
Voice Mimicry: Can mimic voices to lure victims, but can only repeat words it has heard.
Piercing Resistance: Attacks on them with piercing weapons are DR14.
Fragile: Any single strike doing 5 or more damage destroys the skeleton completely.
description: Bleached and clotted bones soaked in gore. Moves without a rattle, whispering dead men's last words.

name: Lich, Undead Necromancer

attacks.name: Necromantic Strike
attacks.special: Paralyzing touch (Presence DR14 every round to break free)

specialRules: Anti-Magic Aura: No one can use Powers near this creature.
Scroll Theft: Every round the lich can steal the contents of a nearby scroll and use this Power against its owner.
Morale: Fearless (undead).
description: A dry, whispering corpse cloaked in burial vestments. A tear in reality that devours all arcane light.

name: Arbint, Troll
specialRules: Easy to hit: Attacks against troll are DR10.
Cowards: Usually retreat if badly wounded.
Vengeful Regrowth: Never forget who hurt them. They grow larger during healing and will return stronger than before. Any HP healed is permanently added to maximum HP, and adds +d6 damage on return.
description: A hulking brute of muscle, moss, and spite. Cowardly when bleed begins, terrifying when vengeance takes hold.

name: Nodh, Zombie

attacks.name: Claw / Bite
attacks.special: Test Toughness DR8 or die within two days and rise as a zombie.

specialRules: Zombie Plague: Anyone bitten must test Toughness DR8 or die within two days before rising as a zombie.
Morale: Fearless (undead).
description: Rotting flesh wrapped in leather scraps. King Fathmu IX seeks their black blood for rumored vaccines.

name: Lady Porcelain, Undead Doll
specialRules: Terrifying Gaze: Demands a Presence DR12 test at the start of combat or be frozen with fear for d4 rounds.
Morale: Fearless (undead).
description: Starved children enclosed in porcelain dolls and left in cathedral windows. Returned to hunt their tormentors.

name: Thinx, Grotesque

attacks.name: Eye-Beam
attacks.special: Terrifying gaze used on 1-2 on d6 each round; always hits!

specialRules: Disturbingly still and hard to discern against gray stone.
Slow: Easy to hit (DR10).
Eye-Beam: Used on 1-2 on a d6 each round. Always hits.
Morale: Fearless (construct/stone).
description: Lurking around churches, stalking graveyards, creeping closer when you look away. Disturbingly still.

name: Aland, Wickhead Knife-Wielder
specialRules: Sneaks up silent as the grave. Skulks in the thickets of Sarkash.
Blinding Flare: Can magically douse all nearby light sources, ignite its own blinding light and attack, then vanish into darkness.
description: Carries a lantern of burning fat. Blows out candles and cuts throats before retreating into the dark.

name: Eulotha, Wyvern

attacks.name: Bite / Venomous Sting
attacks.special: 60% bite / 40% sting. Sting: test Toughness DR14 or suffer 1 hour paralysis.

specialRules: Flight: Where the wyvern fly, crops die.
Venomous Sting: Test Toughness DR14 to avoid one painful hour of paralysis.
description: A scaly nightmare with venomous stinger. Swoops from desolate crags to slaughter cattle and travelers alike.
